title: fusion.explorer-role-input/v1
description: The explorer's immutable role input, the explorer profile's input_schema. The caller's task carries the three domain fields question, path_scope and findings_limit and nothing else. The host adds project_context and output_contract itself and refuses a task that already carries a field of either name (internal/fusionhost/external_explorer.go at 8bab88a); it validates the composed object against this schema, freezes it, and the same bytes travel as RoleCall.input on every role call. Prior answer 67.6: the question and path scope are bounded and the findings limit is at most four; 67.2: project_context is host-supplied and frozen with the attempt; 67.7: output_contract is the actual result schema object, not a filename. No $schema keyword: the host compiles every bundle schema as draft 2020-12 and this file must carry no URL.

question.description: Caller's task: one bounded repository question.

path_scope.description: Caller's task: the repository-relative paths the answer is bounded to; at least one.

findings_limit.description: Caller's task: the most findings the result may carry. The result schema has no maxItems; the host and the module enforce this limit apart from it.

project_context.description: Host-added: the project instruction files the host selected, root AGENTS.md falling back to CLAUDE.md, empty when neither exists. A reference to CLAUDE.md in the role's neutral text means these entries.

path.description: Repository-relative, no traversal, each path once.

sha256.description: Over the supplied UTF-8 bytes of text, in the host's sha256:<hex> form.

output_contract.description: Host-added: the parsed object of the profile's result_schema asset, schemas/explorer-result.v1.json, whose $id this schema does not repeat. The host validates the role's answer against that same object.
